title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xorg-x11-server security update
description: A security update for the xorg-x11-server component in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 addresses a vulnerability (CVE-2026-93520) involving an out-of-bounds write in XKB keycode handling that could lead to arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability is rated as having moderate security impact by Red Hat. The update is available for multiple architectures and variants of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related products.
